objective: Gate2 R2 READ_ONLY de Tablajeria. Convertir la evidencia cruda de Gate2 R1 en un contrato tecnico estructurado para decidir si Gate3 mutation puede abrirse. No construir. No mutar. No tocar Produccion. No DDL. No DML. No backend/frontend changes.

context.gate: Gate2 technical mapping structured READ_ONLY R2
context.functional_domain: Tablajeria convierte un insumo base comprado o existente en inventario en multiples derivados, cortes, subproductos, merma y desperdicio, con trazabilidad, afectacion de inventario, prorrateo de costos, compras reversivas, auditoria y futura contabilidad.

deliverable_contract.gate3_allowed_rule: true only if all required deliverables are completed, blockers is empty, files_to_touch_next_gate is exact and minimal, files_not_to_touch is explicit, tests_required is explicit, no duplication risk remains, and no production or SQL mutation is needed.

technical_scope_to_map: frontend pages and routes under Operaciones and Tablajeria
menu integration for Operaciones > Produccion / Transformacion > Tablajeria
backend routers and endpoints reusable for Operaciones, Inventarios, Productos, Costos, Compras and RBAC
services and repositories reusable without duplication
SQL Server canonical entities for products, inventory, movements, costs, purchases, suppliers, companies, business units, warehouses, users, roles, audit and workflow
identity contract EmpresaID, UnidadNegocioID, ServerID and operational date
data contract for plantilla, orden, ejecucion, insumo base, derivados, merma, subproductos, prorrateo and lote
API candidates for a later surgical mutation gate
risk matrix and explicit Gate3 allowed or blocked decision

queries.name: gate2r2_tablajeria_existing_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (800) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc, o.create_date, o.modify_date FROM sys.objects o WHERE LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaje%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%plantilla%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rendimiento%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%merma%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%subproducto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%transform%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%produccion%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%producción%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: gate2r2_canonical_entities_inventory_cost_purchase
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (1200) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o WHERE LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%empresa%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%unidad%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%sucursal%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%almacén%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%insumo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%movimiento%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%kardex%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%margen%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%receta%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%contab%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%auditoria%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%workflow%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%permiso%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%menu%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: gate2r2_identity_and_quantity_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (1200) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, c.name AS column_name, t.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON c.object_id = o.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types t ON c.user_type_id = t.user_type_id WHERE LOWER(c.name) IN ('empresaid','unidadnegocioid','serverid','sucursalid','almacenid','productoid','insumoid','proveedorid','usuarioid') OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%fechaoperacion%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%cantidad%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%peso%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%merma%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%rendimiento%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%unidadmedida%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name, c.column_id

queries.name: gate2r2_foreign_keys_reuse
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (800) fk.name AS fk_name, SCHEMA_NAME(parent_o.schema_id) AS parent_schema, parent_o.name AS parent_object, SCHEMA_NAME(ref_o.schema_id) AS referenced_schema, ref_o.name AS referenced_object FROM sys.foreign_keys fk INNER JOIN sys.objects parent_o ON fk.parent_object_id = parent_o.object_id INNER JOIN sys.objects ref_o ON fk.referenced_object_id = ref_o.object_id WHERE LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%movimiento%' OR LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%empresa%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%unidad%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%usuario%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' ORDER BY parent_schema, parent_object, fk_name

queries.name: gate2r2_rbac_menu_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (800) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o WHERE LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%permiso%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rol%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rbac%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%modulo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%menu%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%usuario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%autoriz%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: gate2r2_table_row_estimates
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (800) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS table_name, SUM(p.rows) AS estimated_rows FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.partitions p ON o.object_id = p.object_id WHERE o.type = 'U' AND p.index_id IN (0,1) AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%movimiento%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%usuario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%modulo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%permiso%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%lote%') GROUP BY SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id), o.name ORDER BY schema_name, table_name
